facts.text: The orchestrator writes a flow report when it finishes its gate spine, and this run has none — so the run never reached the end of that spine.
The last recorded flow run crashed at gate G3 (harness): render_components_preview failed (exit 1) — harness quality failed.
Replica fidelity is 0.7437 against this run's 0.90 bar — below the bar.

The gate did flag the weakest sections numerically: featureGrid 0.2783, testimonial 0.3088, hero 0.7719. Low band scores are where the composed page diverges most from the source (1 band with no measurable source height is left out of this list).

Do not trust the run manifest over the report beside the page: the run manifest records status "completed" / pipeline_run_completed true, which the gate evidence above does not support; and the manifest's replica score (0.8206) predates the replica that is published here (0.7437 in the report beside the page).
The harness quality artifact on disk reports ok=true — it was written after the flow log above, so it reflects a later rebuild rather than a passing flow run.
